text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A after a gain may have cut short its future potential; I should weigh its outlook and portfolio role before taking profits.","Avoiding trades for months can let risks accumulate; I should review my holdings periodically, even when I prefer not to act.","Selling Stock E at a large loss was difficult, but I should assess what it can earn from here rather than let my purchase price dictate whether I hold it."]}
